title: Update a translation of a file in a Git repo — deepl_update
text: deepl_branch_update() automatic needs configuration. branch, edits made Rmd/qmd/md file, update translations Rmd/qmd/md file name language code. instance branch commits updating pkg_building.Rmd, deepl_branch_update() update pkg_building.es.Rmd. run PR updated pkg_building.Rmd pkg_building.es.Rmd. Make sure read section Markdown formatting. configuration needed must live _deepl.yml root Git repo. must contains fields: "preferences" source-target pair, indicates preference formality, glossary yaml_fields arguments deepl_translate(). "excludes" indicates files exclude automatic detection (Rmd/qmd/md files otherwise considered). used glob arguments calls fs::dir_ls(). "languages" language code used file names, indicates DeepL API code use source target language. Example (_deepl.yml):
code: preferences:   - source: en     target: es-419     formality: less     glossary: "glosario"     yaml_fields: ["title"]   - source: en     target: pt-br     formality: less     yaml_fields: ["title", "description"]   - source: pt     target: en-us     formality: prefer_less     yaml_fields: ["title", "description"]   - source: es     target: en-us     formality: prefer_less     yaml_fields: ["title", "description"]  excludes: ["*.md"]  languages:   - extension: es     target: es-419     source: es   - extension: ''     target: en-us     source: en   - extension: pt     target: pt-br     source: pt
